description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryController class, a PHP controller in the OrangeHRM system responsible for managing employee salary data, including preparing data for salary-related views and handling permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryController
classes.description: A PHP controller class managing employee salary views and data within the OrangeHRM system, extending base views and incorporating services and translation traits.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance used to retrieve salary-related data such as currencies, pay grades, and pay periods.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and UI components for rendering the employee salary view. Retrieves employee number, fetches salary data, sets up Vue component properties, and permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups required for permission checks, in this case 'salary_details'.
